features.behavior: Elite rule rows parse with their parameters; bad rows fail the load
Ship data holds the four rules of the spec, no reward_materials, valid status ids
An elite battle installs the rule state; enemy max HP is the standard value plus elite.health_percent, attack unchanged
Spell-fed queues a bonus per party Spell use and applies it at the next round start, capped
Escalating adds the bonus once per round from from_round, capped
Thorned costs a party melee attacker HP per enemy hit, never below 1 HP
Unyielding makes every enemy immune to the rule's statuses
The HUD line is empty without an elite state or outside the Battle phase; otherwise name, text, affected skills and bonus suffixes
An elite win opens a strict boss-table rune offer (no rarity of weight 0, also with a dry pool) and pays no extra materials
The fork panel elite detail is the HP line, the rule text, the affected skills and the uncommon-or-better reward
Round-start bonus and thorn damage write the exact feed lines
